description:
Maven/JPMS wrapper activating Dirac (MicroProfile Metrics 5.1) in a vidocq deployment.
        No own Java class — the integration relies on dirac-cdi-vauban's BuildCompatibleExtension
        (discovery of @Counted/@Timed/@Gauge + @ApplicationScoped MetricRegistry producers) and the
        JAX-RS @Path scanning of CassiniExtension, which auto-mounts MetricsResource (@Path("/metrics")).
        Mirrors vidocq-runtime-knock-extension (ADR-002 in the knock repo).
